notes: v0.5 rebuild on a clean baseline. Adds a language layer (greenwash/lang.py) so the same rules read English, Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) and Simplified Chinese (mainland) reports: 民國 years, Chinese magnitude units (公噸/萬噸/百萬噸/億噸), Chinese scope labels (範疇一/范围一/間接排放) and Chinese claim verbs. Output schema is unchanged (1.2). English behaviour is unchanged: the 52 pre-existing tests pass unmodified. Verified on 8 real Taiwan sustainability reports: claim candidates 190 -> 1234, numeric observations 0 -> 6 (TSMC p228). The other 7 reports lay the scopes out as columns, which this one-series parser still abstains on by design. examples/* are frozen v0.4 artifacts and were not regenerated: the PDF path needs Poppler's pdftotext, which the build host does not have.

packaging.system_dependency: Poppler pdftotext (PDF input only; cannot be declared in metadata)
packaging.verified: uv build -> wheel contains only greenwash/; installed into a clean venv; console script, extract and apply-review all run outside the source tree
